title: Permit to Core / Drill / Cut
name: Permit to Core / Drill / Cut
description: Controls intrusive coring, drilling, chasing, sawing and cutting where hidden services, structure, fire compartmentation, dust, noise or falling debris may be affected.

sections.title: PRE-INTRUSIVE CHECKS
items: Current drawings / surveys have been reviewed
The proposed penetration has been marked and positively identified
Hidden electrical, gas, water, fire, data and other services have been considered
Suitable locating / scanning methods have been used where required
The opposite side / below the work area has been checked
Structural implications have been reviewed where applicable

fields.label: Service Detection / Scan Method and Result

sections.title: WORK AREA CONTROLS
items: Work area and opposite side are protected from falling debris
Dust / silica controls are suitable for the method
Noise and vibration impacts are controlled
Water / slurry is contained and disposed of safely
Required services have been isolated before penetration
Suitable PPE / RPE and extraction are provided

sections.title: COMPLETION
items: Cutting / drilling is complete and the opening is left safe
Fire stopping / weatherproofing requirements are identified
Temporary covers or edge protection are installed where required
Debris, slurry and equipment are removed
Any damaged or unexpected service / structure issue has been reported
